data.one_liner: Annotations to mark and configure business model classes for code generation of .proto and Dart mappers.
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations that mark business model classes for code generation. Works with the proto_generator package to generate .proto files and Dart mapper classes.
use_when: You are using Protocol Buffers in your Dart application and need to map them to business model classes.
You want automated code generation for .proto files from existing classes.
avoid_when: You are not using Protocol Buffers or gRPC in your application.
You prefer writing .proto files and mapping code manually.
strengths: Automates the generation of .proto files and Dart mapper classes.
Supports well-known types, polymorphism, and configuration options via annotations.
weaknesses: Requires a separate generator package to perform the actual code generation.
Adds external dependencies like grpc and protobuf to your project.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to your dependencies alongside a code generator.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:proto_annotations/proto_annotations.py';

// Use annotations on your models
